contract: transport(lattice, occupancies, barrier_model, temperature_k, budget) -> exactly budget['events'] [waiting_time_seconds, directed_edge_index] pairs. For the pinned NASICON model, Na state is0 and vacancy1; Si/P framework states remain fixed. barrier_model['nasicon_lce'] supplies occupation-dependent decorated LCE sums, source fitted parameters, local environments and directed periodic hop vectors. Rates are nu*exp(-(E_KRA+direction*DeltaE_site/2)/(kBT)). Preserve particle identity, exclusion and unwrapped periodic displacement. Evaluator independently audits clocks/events and compares 1000-event mean tagged-ion MSD/(6 mean physical time) against exact propagation over1680 tagged states. Score candidate runtime*relative_standard_error^2 across64 replicas. This bounded source illustrative model does not establish bulk/asymptotic conductivity or a new validated material fit.
